rarityEvidence: One bounded recursive group combines total-KJV word occurrence, word-form length prevalence, exact-phrase occurrence, shared-segment prevalence, letter-pattern prevalence, and within-verse repetition. These facts do not multiply Word, Letter, Order, or morphology scores separately.
orderEvidence: Deterministic rarity-and-length-weighted optimal monotonic token alignment; recursive mean of ordered coverage, relative-position agreement, pair-direction agreement, gap agreement, and continuity. Reversal and separation decay continuously but remain positive when shared wording exists.
finalScoreFormula: (1661 * textual_score + 129 * proximity_score) / 1790; exact repeated displayed text remains 1.000 and nonidentity results remain capped below it.
textualGroupCombination: For each group, observed component values recursively weight themselves: sum(value^2) / sum(value). No fixed internal percentages.
exactPhraseTreatment: An exact continuous phrase of two or more words requires the same punctuation and spacing. It is a virtual exact word using Word/Words weight, exact displayed-phrase occurrence rarity, and combined-letter word-length value, plus the small Line/Verse textual component. A punctuation-different phrase retains reduced Word evidence through the same measured token, surface, case, punctuation/spacing, and display-character layers used for complete verses, but receives no Exact-Line component.
punctuationTokenization: Apostrophes and hyphens/dashes inside letter-number forms are treated symmetrically: the exact punctuated form is retained as one token and punctuation-delimited components are exposed concurrently for morphology. Neither mark imposes an exclusive one-token or two-token interpretation.
letterPatternWeights: No hand-set type multipliers; strength comes from observed length, coverage, position, and corpus fragment/character frequency.
completeSequenceIdentity: Recursive mean of token identity, surface-token agreement, exact-case characters, punctuation/spacing, and displayed characters; no fixed 0.995/0.985 tiers.
segmentEvidence: shared letters × coverage of both forms × corpus positional rarity × observed positional exactness
capitalization: literal case-position agreement only; no grammatical or sentence-initial discount
notes: Algorithm 2.9 binds all numerical rarity amplification to one textual group whose weight is the 253 exact KJV occurrences of only. Structural evidence remains structural; rarity enters the score once. The 61 exact occurrences of order give word-order evidence its own textual group, and the combined 129 exact-token occurrences of neighbour (107) and neighbours (22) give canonical proximity direct final-score influence. Possessive neighbour's/neighbour’s forms remain distinct tokens.
